reasoning: The question asks about a one-week change in EM corporate bond spreads (Oct 11 to Oct 18, 2026). The evidence shows significant global bond market stress in early October 2026: US Treasury yields hit 20-year highs (5.36%), European sovereign yields rose, and there's a global bond sell-off affecting emerging markets (Nigerian Eurobonds down ~10% in two months). This risk-off environment typically causes EM corporate spreads to widen. However, weekly spread movements are inherently noisy and can go either direction. Given the stressed market backdrop but acknowledging uncertainty in short-term movements, I estimate a moderate probability of spread increase.
